name: Umbrawl
summary:
Umbrawl pits you against other shadow beings in the Umbral Plane. Customize your shadow character, and enter the Umbral Forest to fight other shadow beings and claim the crown. 

Utilizes a completely unique hand walking and flying locomotion.
